turns.user: I'm taking a bus to the airport; does my ordinary single ticket work?
turns.agent:
It depends which airport bus you mean:

100E Airport Express: No. An ordinary single ticket is not valid on 100E. The snapshot lists a full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF. Some qualifying passes can use a 1,000 HUF add-on, but eligibility depends on the exact pass.
200E: Yes, it follows ordinary ticket and pass rules, so an ordinary single ticket applies.

These details come from the 5 November 2026 snapshot; I haven’t live-checked today’s fare rules. See BKK’s airport shuttle ticket and add-on rules and airport express information. Which bus route—100E or 200E—are you taking?

links.text: airport shuttle ticket and add-on rules

turns.agent: Yes—an ordinary single ticket works on bus 200E; it follows ordinary ticket rules. That’s based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. BKK airport express information.
